text: For two events, $P(A) = \dfrac{4}{5}$, $P(B) = \dfrac{1}{2}$ and $P(A \cap B) = \dfrac{2}{5}$. Show that A and B are independent, and find $P(A \cup B)$.

points.text: $P(A)P(B) = \dfrac{4}{5} \times \dfrac{1}{2} = \dfrac{2}{5}$.
This equals $P(A \cap B)$, so the events are independent.
$P(A \cup B) = \dfrac{4}{5} + \dfrac{1}{2} - \dfrac{2}{5} = \dfrac{9}{10}$.
